console_host.note: The curation console (reference_console.py) is designed to run entirely locally against the mirrored corpus/seed in corpus_support/ and 01_seed/ - it does not require a live connection to Cluster-B or Cluster A during a curation session.

data_provenance_host.note: All candidate artifacts, the corpus, the source PDFs, and the hierarchy overlay were located and freshly hashed on Cluster-B on 2026-08-24 - see 00_freeze/CANDIDATE_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json for every absolute path and sha256.

editor_used_for_multiline_fields.note: reference_console.py's memo/edit-reference commands shell out to this editor for multi-line text entry; set $EDITOR before launching the console to use a different one.
